artifact_retention: Pull and review promptly; keep this run's private input/output prefixes at most 30 days without renewed storage approval.
authorization: Draft only: the user's explicit approval must name this SHA256 and cover its private uploads, one job and bounded storage

forecast.basis: A1500 measured 368.4 input tokens/s and 6,386 s for the dev screen on the same t4-small; $0.40/h. Planning estimates, not caps.

decision_rule.rule: A1500-v4 replaces A1500 as the trained finalist for the final evaluation if its dev strict score is higher than A1500's on the same 95 tasks; a tie keeps A1500

pass_criteria: account, rate, pins and private upload verified; every training and dev reference passes before model use
fresh factory encoding matches the stored v4 counts (2,798,156 inputs, 347,808 targets per pass; 1,425/75, A1500's split)
180 finite committed optimizer updates via the AgentTune factory, none skipped; ledger covers all
validation losses finite; GPU memory events after load, every update, completion and any OOM
the dev step reloads the final adapter and its tensors exactly equal the saved step-180 adapter
95 dev episodes with one finite projected inference position; AuditKIT agrees with every saved score
abort_criteria: wrong account or higher hardware price
missing memory measurement, full-prompt inference projection or AuditKIT disagreement
reporting: Strict, fallback and set dev accuracy against A1500's 37/95, paired discordant tasks, amendment-8 shapes, recoveries after a failed query, what follows a failed query, partial-query use, loss, time, cost and memory are reported whatever they are.
